title: Proposed data and analytics engineers, with clear capacity and staffing rates

slides.title: Two complementary engineers plus 10% engagement support for six months
bullets: **Capacity:** senior DE 100%, senior analytics engineer 100%, engagement lead 10%; all profiles and availability to verify.
**Start:** 1 December 2026, both planned from that date, confirmed in writing at signature; interviews at your convenience
**Working mode:** your backlog, your standards, your repos; daily collaboration in your chat tool, no extra vendor layer

**Plain lineage, no stock graphics:** every pipeline we touch is documented as source table → Bronze → Silver → Gold → BI dataset (Unity Catalog lineage if enabled, otherwise a lineage page in your repo)
**Low friction:** one named contact, monthly 1-page report, no steering ceremonies
**Draft capacity fee: EUR 227,250** for six planning months, EUR 37,875/month. Extension uses the same role rates and requires an availability check.

slides.title: Our engineers work inside your lakehouse as it is: lineage from SAP to report, no stock graphics
bullets: We plug into your existing Azure Databricks setup, repos and conventions; we add no tools of our own.
Every pipeline we touch has a plain end-to-end lineage, and that lineage is what we show in reviews. Scope follows your backlog; we add no side projects.

slides.title: EUR 227,250 for six months of stated capacity
bullets: Each planning month is 20 working days; actual holidays and absences must be reconciled before signature.
DE EUR 115/h, analytics EUR 125/h; lead EUR 125/h is proposed for owner confirmation. Additional capacity is priced by role, not a blanket engineer-month discount.
Extension and replacements require verified resources. Written scope and change control apply; VAT, travel and cloud consumption excluded.
slides.note: Draft capacity price, not proof of candidate availability. The previous EUR 8,000 per engineer-month is superseded because it breached the stated hourly floors.

slides.title: Staffing review and decision before submission
bullets: Rauno / Codex staffing review: maximum two architects respected; complementary roles included; DE/DA floors and AI premium applied to the stated role scope.
This revision replaces the lower draft price for the same capacity. If the buyer budget is lower, reduce scoped work or hours and re-estimate; do not discount below hourly minima.
Candidate CVs, credentials, language skills, exact dates and actual availability remain unverified. Nominate and confirm before buyer submission.
Final fixed-price deliverables, risk allowance and the proposed non-DE rates require offer-owner review. This is not a human approval or a request to send.
